collection.title: Maserati Ghibli 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Maserati Ghibli 2013 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Maserati Ghibli 2013 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
